verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly shows that Rootly incidents carry roles and action items: Ask Rootly AI is grounded in an incident's 'roles', and AI Summaries draw on 'action items'. Nothing documents defining specific roles such as commander or comms lead, assigning them, or running task checklists during response. Workflow automation and retrospective action-item tracking are adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented role definitions and assignment (commander, comms lead), configurable incident task checklists or playbooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, incidents carry defined roles (commander, comms lead) and task checklists so response stays coordinated under pressure

citations.quote: a read-only chat grounded in that incident's live timeline, roles, alerts, severity, and status
